title: The derived image of a single object through any specified injective resolution
statement: For abelian categories C and D equipped with derived categories, with enough injectives in C, and an additive functor F:C→D and a specified injective resolution R of X, construct the bounded-below complex F(R) and a canonical isomorphism RF(X[0])≅Q(F(R)). It commutes with every lift between specified injective resolutions of a map of the resolved objects.

source.place: Tag 0156; rightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIsoQ and its hom_naturality theorem, generalized to a supplied resolution.

proof.text: Use the localized augmentation from the single complex to the specified injective resolution, together with the canonical single-complex and quotient comparison isomorphisms. Apply RF, then invert the derived unit on the injective complex. Naturality is the augmentation square after localization followed by naturality of the inverse unit. This generalizes the proved PlusSingle formula by replacing its chosen injective resolution with the supplied one.

theorem specifiedResolutionDerivedSingleIso_naturality {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    (R : InjectiveResolution X) (R' : InjectiveResolution Y) (φ : R.Hom R' f) :
    F.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C 0).map f) ≫
        (F.specifiedResolutionDerivedSingleIso R').hom =
      (F.specifiedResolutionDerivedSingleIso R).hom ≫
        DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.map (ObjectProperty.homMk
          ((F.mapHomologicalComplex _).map φ.hom') :
            F.specifiedResolutionComplex R ⟶ F.specifiedResolutionComplex R')
